title: Zion: 4,000 visitors became 5 million #Shorts
description:
In 1920 fewer than 4,000 people visited Zion. In 2021 more than five million did, a record. The water and the rock that make Zion beautiful never stop moving.

▶ Full documentary (Zion, Part 1: Zion's Deadliest Day): https://youtu.be/Hlr80lyDlwA

#Shorts #Zion #History #NationalParks
